Masterpiece modern Japanese anime illustration, ultra detailed, delicate painterly rendering with fine line art and soft depth of field. Early spring afternoon at an old abandoned shrine gate in Gensokyo. A single ancient peach tree in full bloom leans over a weathered stone torii and a moss-covered stone step, its branches heavy with pale pink blossoms that fill the upper left of the frame and scatter petals through the air. Reimu Hakurei stands beneath the tree in her red-and-white sleeveless shrine maiden outfit, detached white sleeves, a red ribbon tying her long black hair, a small white neck scarf and red hair ornament. She has stopped in the middle of the path and looks up at the blossoms, one hand lifted with the palm open to catch a falling petal, the other hand hanging loosely at her side holding a folded paper talisman. Her expression is quiet and faintly wistful, lips slightly parted, eyes unfocused as if remembering a day that will not come back. Petals settle on her shoulders, in her hair and on the stone step; a few drift across the foreground out of focus. Soft spring sunlight filters through the canopy as warm dappled light on her face and sleeves, the background dissolving into pale misty green and cream. Colour palette: soft peach pink, warm cream sunlight, muted moss green, one accent of vermilion from her outfit. Composition: she stands in the left-centre, full body, facing slightly right and upward; the rightmost quarter of the canvas is open misty sky deliberately kept as quiet negative space for a small column of vertical calligraphy that must stay subtle and never cover the figure or the blossoms. Extremely detailed petal translucency, fabric folds, fine hair strands, subtle paper grain, gentle melancholic spring atmosphere.
